dedupe_keys.name: ilu ds1 metropolitano de lisboa metro lisboa title validation

description: The project catalogue identifies a restricted collection of Metro Lisboa passenger smart-card validations, created by Metropolitano de Lisboa and collected through the Lisbon municipality. Its stated geographic coverage is Lisbon, Odivelas and Amadora councils. The catalogue explicitly records use in fare-based passenger route inference, dynamic origin-destination estimation and LINES transport resilience assessment. These relationships establish a modelling-input role without asserting that every study used identical extracts. The records are subject to a non-disclosure agreement. File format, sampling interval, date range, record count and field schema are not stated. The published maps and model descriptions are separate products and do not release these source validations. The catalogue supplies descriptive evidence, not a public download or a verified access-request procedure. The related route-choice model uses this input. Cost and licence terms are unknown.
